Necroing this thread because it's still relevant, the voice overs in the tutorial definitely feel like AI due to the lack of proper pauses in between sentences. The intro/trailer's live action section is confirmed to be AI by Chillyroom themselves.

https://x.com/ChillyRoom/status/2066436377345200274

It needs to be disclosed on the steam page, even if it is going to be temporary. Plenty of games utilize AI for placeholder assets and officialize them later with original content. Plenty of games also just us AI as it is. In either case, Steam's got policies. I don't know why Asian indie studios keep omitting this stuff on their Steam pages. Calvary Girls tried to hide that it used Grok to animate the portraits. After several years of no complaints, they stealth adding "basic animation" in a patch last year. It wasn't until a bunch of people started complaining that it was undisclosed that they added a notice.
